entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: An information element that the UE includes to signal a UE radio capability ID to the network when specific conditions are met.

entities.name: UE is not in NB-N1 mode
entities.description: Condition that the UE is not operating in NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: UE supports RACS
entities.description: Condition that the UE supports RACS (Radio Access Capability Signaling).

entities.name: UE needs to signal UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Condition that the UE needs to signal a UE radio capability ID to the network.

relations.description: The inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that the UE is not in NB-N1 mode.
The inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that the UE supports RACS.
The inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that the UE needs to signal the ID to the network.
